phase: Adaptive DEVELOPMENT prompt ablation; not independent confirmation
baseline: Previously fixed public-first execution-consensus selection on four original candidates
trigger: One or more PUBLIC example assertions fail on the baseline-selected candidate
replacement: A new candidate replaces the baseline only if it passes strictly more public assertions; otherwise baseline is retained
prompt_source: Original independent-resampling messages plus a fixed task-independent user-message suffix in the concise arm only.
seed_rule: sha256('transfer:20260908:{task_id}')[:8] interpreted as hex integer; same seed in both arms
call_budget: Three cached controls and exactly three new concise-prompt calls; no new tests.
failure_policy: No answer-quality retries. All incomplete or malformed attempts retained; all 40 denominators kept.
primary_development_comparison: Concise instruction versus cached original instruction at the same 2048 maximum output tokens on all three public-failure triggers; retain all 40 tasks.
secondary_comparisons: Both arms versus the selected baseline; retain every failure.
reason_for_primary: Doubling the cap failed; test completion-oriented prompting without increasing the cap.
confirmation: Do not rerun or retune the completed 180-task experiment; calibration and reserve untouched.
prompt_suffix: Reason briefly and avoid repeating alternatives. Finish your reasoning promptly, then provide the complete Python implementation in a code block.
